#584 · Snowstorm Pokémon

Vanilluxe

Ice

Unova · Generation 5

Vanilluxe is an Ice-type Snowstorm Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 57.5 kg. It evolves from Vanillish. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (110), with a base stat total of 535.
